reviews.text: Excellent service and highly trained staff

My youngest puppy just had surgery. I'm thrilled with everything: the love and care, the dedication with which they looked after him. The cleanliness, the modern medical equipment, everything is up-to-date and advanced. I highly recommend them.

Excellent experience from start to finish! I took my Papuchi to this veterinary clinic and couldn’t be happier or more grateful to the entire team. From the front desk to the veterinarian and technicians, everyone was kind, attentive, and professional. Everything was clearly explained, and the veterinarian took the time to listen to my concerns and was very caring with Papuchi. The treatment was exactly what he needed, and he improved very quickly, which gave me great peace of mind.You can truly tell this team cares about animals and their well-being. I’m very grateful for the wonderful care and kindness they showed Papuchi. I highly recommend this clinic! 🐾❤️
I didn't go in, but my husband says it's very organized.

I've taken my dog ​​Clifford to this clinic several times; he's had two surgeries and I have no complaints. The doctors are very professional and knowledgeable, the staff is attentive and friendly, and they care about the animals' well-being.
Brought our cat to get his annual check up. They have a great team and all are professional. From the vet to the techs, they were gentle and kind with our cat.

I wanted to leave this review because this clinic is truly amazing. They helped me with my kitten when I didn't have enough resources, and they still did everything they could just to make sure my baby was okay. That says so much about their kind hearts.

Dr. García was incredibly kind and treated my cat with amazing care and dedication. I also want to thank Gerardo and Daniela, who helped us so much throughout the entire process. They were always attentive, with a super humane and understanding attitude.

I am truly grateful for everything they did for us. I would definitely come back here a thousand times. Highly recommended! 🐾
I've been to other veterinary clinics, and this one is nothing like it. The staff, especially Rolando, provides exceptional care. I recommend it 100%.
Horrible place, terrible service. If you can go somewhere else, go for it. For the price they charge there, it's better to be treated somewhere that values ​​your pet and your money.

The best of the best 100% recommended really good work ethic and everything clear Oscar Perojo really helpful and knowledgeable also Gerardo Garcia great surgeon really great team appreciate their help
Thank you!

We’ve been coming to this animal hospital for 7 years with our three dogs and two cats, and sadly it no longer feels like the place we trusted for so long. The team we relied on for years is completely different now, and it feels no different than any regular veterinary clinic.

Dr. Randy Dominguez performed surgery for my cat and he was excellent. Our family also truly admired Dr. Cepero. He was an outstanding doctor with reasonable pricing and genuine care. However, Dr. Cepero has been gone for the past few months, and the experience since then has changed significantly.

With the new doctor we met, it started to feel like the focus shifted more toward charging extra rather than what is truly necessary. We were encouraged to pay for things we didn’t need, and it created a feeling that money comes first, which broke our trust.

What also shocked me was the pricing difference compared to last year. For the annual vaccines and treatment for my dog’s chronic infection, we paid a little over $500 last year. This year, just last month, we ended up paying around $900 for the same type of visit and care.

For example, Prednisone 5 mg is about $5 for 30 tablets on Chewy, but here we were charged $35 for just 5 tablets. Also, even though I told them I already have ear cleaning solution at home, they still sold us a $24 lotion. When signing, it was listed under “medication,” so it was difficult to question it in the moment.

I never used to feel this way about this hospital, and it’s disappointing after so many years. If Dr. Cepero does not return soon, we will be switching to another veterinary clinic.
Bring your dog here ! Amazing staff from the receptionist to the doctors !

I went to this hospital to get a second opinion on my dog.  They told me my dog needed emergency surgery which I scheduled. They were pushing for me to do the surgery the same day but I explained I had a preplanned trip. During my trip, my sons helped me care for my dog who started to progressively get better.  I called to postpone the surgery to see if the improvement was consistent.  After my dog improved, I called the office to cancel the surgery. I was unable to get a hold of them during the holidays.  At the end of December  someone told me that they would return my call because "they were very busy".  I finally got a hold of someone who said my money was nonrefundable. I strongly encourage everyone to please be cautious when going to this hospital as their interests are more financial than actually helping animals.  I will continue to dispute this charge as everyone knows that care for animals is very expensive and for people to take advantage is unfathomable.

This is the best vet I’ve been to. They’re patient, caring, and always treat me really well. The receptionists are incredibly kind and welcoming, and the whole team makes you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in.

Laura :

I couldn’t be more grateful for the care my pet and I received at this clinic. The entire team was incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely compassionate. They treated my pet with so much love and took the time to explain everything clearly, always keeping my budget in mind without ever compromising the quality of care. It’s rare to find a place that understands both the emotional and financial side of having a sick pet, and they truly went above and beyond. I’m forever thankful for their honesty, empathy, and dedication. Highly recommended!
Very professional and friendly. Very grateful.

Thanks to Dr. García’s guidance and recommendations, my pet has made an incredible recovery. I am truly amazed at how quickly and smoothly everything improved once we followed his treatment plan. His knowledge, patience, and genuine care made all the difference.

The entire staff was equally wonderful and always willing to help with anything we needed. From the front desk to the techs, everyone treated us with respect and warmth, making every visit feel reassuring. I’m beyond grateful for the exceptional care my pet received here. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate veterinary team!

Do not recommend.  Receptionist are heartless and cold.   Every phone call is a struggle.  All they want you to do is come in for an appt.  When I called Frantic they had no compassion and were of no help.  They just want ur money.  Don’t go.

Not used to leaving reviews, but I wanted to give a shoutout to the whole team! From the receptionists that always welcome you with a warm smile, to Roland, Erick, Dr. Dominguez, and everyone who works at Animal Care and Surgical Hospital. They have been taking amazing care of my dog Paco during his TPLO surgery recovery. Such a caring team. I will always be grateful! Thank you
Amazing animal care, made my dog feel super comfortable. Receptionist is super sweet. Highly recommend if you’re looking for the best pet care.
Excellent service, the staff was great and they resolved my problem with my dog.
Excellent service, delighted.

I cannot thank this veterinary team enough for saving Raymond’s (my dog) life after a severe Rottweiler bite. From the moment I rushed through the door, the entire staff acted with urgency, compassion, and incredible skill. They immediately stabilized my dog, kept me informed every step of the way, and handled an extremely frightening situation with absolute professionalism.
Dr Cepero and his staff's expertise was extraordinary. They treated my dog with such gentleness and precision, addressing not only the visible wounds but the infection that he had. Their quick decisions and thorough care made all the difference, and I truly believe my dog would not be here today without them.
Beyond the medical care, the kindness they showed—reassuring me, explaining the treatment plan clearly, and following up afterward—meant the world to me. It’s rare to find a team that combines such exceptional medical talent with genuine compassion.
I am forever grateful for everything they did. If you are looking for a vet who will treat your pet like family and go above and beyond, this is the place. They gave my dog a second chance at life, and I will never forget it.

Thanks for the love and the 5-star review! 

Warm Regards, 
Animal Care & Surgical Hospital Team
Thank you!
Clean clinic and staff, very professional technicians and doctors, excellent after-sales service.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 – Truly the Best Care for Pets!

My family has trusted Animal Care & Surgical Hospital for years with Dr. Cepero —my dad always brought his pitties here when I was younger. Now that I’m living on my own with my own fur babies, I don’t hesitate to bring them here for anything, whether it’s a simple check-up, vaccines, or even surgery.

I recently brought in my pitbull, SuNi, for his annual vaccinations, and everything went smoothly as always. The staff handled him with so much care and professionalism.

Today, I brought in a rescued cat that was suffering from seizures, and once again, the compassion and expertise of the vets amazed me. They go above and beyond to make sure every animal gets the best care possible.

There truly is no care for your pets like the care you’ll find here. They treat every animal like family, and it gives me so much peace of mind knowing my babies are in their hands.

10/10 – Always recommend Animal Care & Surgical Hospital!
My Shiba had a knee surgery and I couldn’t be happier with this veterinarian surgical center. The doctor did an excellent job and staff were super attentive.
Kind and friendly staff and the veterinarians are very thoughtful and compassionate.

We could not be happier with the services we received for our dog Luna here. Luna needed surgery for her ACL and the team at Animal Care and Surgical were great. Luna's surgery was clean, her recovery was great, and the follow-up was appreciated. I would highly recommend to anyone needing great care for their pet!
Thank you!

Animal Care Surgical Hospital took care of our beloved Buddy from his happiest, healthiest days through his final moments.
They gave him loving, professional attention for his vaccines, check-ups,  surgeries  and later when he became ill. Even on the day we had to say goodbye, they treated him with respect and compassion, and helped us with all the funeral arrangements. We are forever grateful for their kindness and genuine love for pets.
The hospital is fantastic, with high-quality doctors and wonderful treatment for both clients and pets. I felt very comfortable there. I recommend it 100%.

I'm thrilled with the care my kitten received. Thanks to the skilled hands of the specialists, my baby is doing perfectly. It's the best place to care for your pet. Look how well he is now, thanks to them! 🥰 …
Amazing service! 10/10 recommend to everyone in Miami!

And this is without labs since he recently had them done.  CT is unnecessary. X-ray would have sufficed.  Major Ripoff!!! Went ahead and scheduled his surgery at the other animal hospital and paying $1,500.00 for all

Thanks for the five-star rating, Lucas. We appreciate your feedback; it helps people looking for quality animal care learn more about our Animal Care and Surgical Hospital. We're always here whenever you need us.

I was referred here from my vet for my dog to have an endoscopy, the girl that answered the phone said they don't offer that but they're a surgical center and they literally have a video of it happening on their website? This place is ghetto and ridiculous

Negative stars if I could. The most unprofessional human or animal facility I have ever encountered in my entire life. Before I go, I call the facility like a normal  person to confirm I can come after my regular vet refers me to do an endoscopy. The receptionist tells me they dont offer it lol. They call me back 10 min later to apologize and say its her first day. They they proceed to call me 3x over the next hour to cancel and reschedule my appt twice 🙃.

I finally confirm for 2 days later. They tell me I can drop my dog off at 9 am and pick him up later.

I waste an entire hour bc the receptionist couldn't email my previous vet to have the xrays sent over. I leave and tell them to send me everything over email.

The same girl tells me I need to drive an hour back from Southbeach because now they have an estimate and need me to sign. EVEN when I asked to do that before I left. They wouldnt even give me a QUOTE on the surgery cost before I paid for xrays we already had.

I then go to ask for my dog back to take him to a real care facility. The Clinic. Manager is then baffled im not okay with paying people $6,000 to take care of me dog when they cant even send an email or transfer a phone call without hanging up.

BTW this was my first time there. I never want you or your pets to go through this ever! STAY FAR AWAY go to VEG miami 24/7 support who actually are true medical professionals and care about your pets. Its also the only emergency pet facility that you can stay with your pet while they operate.

****they also dont charge a ridiculous 3% transaction fee bc they aren't too cheap to pay for it like animal surgical hospital

Ive posted both a picture of their extra fee policy they dont tell you about, and their incessant calling. These people don't know how to leave a voicemail or the fact that you are a working professional.

Dr. Cepero is the best vet in Miami. He's very kind and treats our pets and their owners well.

Thank you, Dr. Cepero, for always looking out for our pets.

Bijoux and Olga
